groups.instruction: Complete the flow-chart below. Choose FIVE answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-I, next to questions 11-15.

notes.text: Subscribe to the service online to receive a card
↓ At the station, log on at the computer terminal
↓ Select a bike by using the {{11}}
↓ Release the bike by using the {{12}} of your chosen bike
↓ Remove the bike from the {{13}} (You have ten seconds.)
↓ Make sure you have a {{14}} before setting off
↓ At the end of your journey, return the bike to a station and secure in place (A {{15}} will tell you the bike is locked correctly.)

groups.instruction: Label the plan (see the plan on the test paper). Write the correct letter, A-H, next to questions 16-20.
